item.text: Pillow is available, so I can adjust the image directly without installing anything. I’ll use a moderate dimming level so the wallpaper is toned down while preserving the original.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /home/user/.local/share/backgrounds && python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('/usr/share/backgrounds/warty-final-ubuntu.png')
dst = Path('/home/user/.local/share/backgrounds/warty-final-ubuntu-dimmed.png')
img = Image.open(src).convert('RGBA')
img = ImageEnhance.Brightness(img).enhance(0.62)
# Preserve visual quality while keeping file size modest.
img.save(dst, optimize=True)
print(dst)
PY
uri=\"file:///home/user/.local/share/backgrounds/warty-final-ubuntu-dimmed.png\"
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri \""'$uri"
gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri-dark "$uri" 2>/dev/null || true
ls -lh /home/user/.local/share/backgrounds/warty-final-ubuntu-dimmed.png
gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri'
